title: Cardinal DriveSense Driving Data — Use, Retention and Score Disputes
content:
**Statement.** Trip-level driving data collected under Cardinal DriveSense is kept for the program's retention period and is used only to set the DriveSense adjustment and the per-mile charge. Driving data is never shared outside Cardinal for marketing and never used to decide a claim. A customer who disputes a monthly score is shown the trip events behind it; the score itself is not changed at the desk, and an error in the data source is referred to the DriveSense support team.

## Data settings by program

| Program | Days trip-level data is kept | Shared outside Cardinal for marketing | Used to decide claims |
|---|---|---|---|
| Cardinal DriveSense Mobile | 365 | No | No |
| Cardinal DriveSense Plug-In | 365 | No | No |
| Cardinal DriveSense Connected Car | 365 | No | No |
| Cardinal DriveSense Teen Coach | 365 | No | No |
| Cardinal DriveSense Miles Mobile | 365 | No | No |
| Cardinal DriveSense Miles Plug-In | 365 | No | No |

## Permitted and excluded uses

| Use of driving data | Permitted |
|---|---|
| Setting the DriveSense discount or surcharge | Yes |
| Setting the per-mile charge on a pay-per-mile program | Yes |
| Sharing outside Cardinal for marketing | No |
| Deciding a claim | No |

## A disputed monthly score

| Element | Treatment |
|---|---|
| What the customer is shown | The trip events behind the disputed monthly score |
| The score | Not changed at the desk |
| An error in the data source | Referred to the DriveSense support team |

## Questions and answers

**Can a claim on the vehicle be decided on what the driving data shows?**
No. Driving data is never used to decide a claim, on any program.

**How long is a trip kept?**
Trip-level data is kept for 365 days on every program.

**A customer believes a month's score is too low. What can be done at the desk?**
The customer is shown the trip events behind that score. The score is not changed at the desk; where the data source is in error, the matter is referred to the DriveSense support team.
